userStories.title: Extract web ApprovalContext and Plannotator URL boundary
userStories.description: As a web developer, I want a shared module for parsing run approval metadata and validating Plannotator review URLs, so that approval context is safely and consistently handled across the dashboard and workflow logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/lib/approval-context.ts defining WebApprovalContextType ('approval' | 'plannotator_gate' | 'child_workflow' | 'interactive_loop' | 'writeback') and WebApprovalContext interface.

Implement readApprovalContext(value: unknown): WebApprovalContext | null, validating required nodeId and message strings, optional enum types, optional childRunId/document strings, nullable/string reviewUrl, and optional approved/rejected/null resolved state.
Implement getPlannotatorReviewUrl(input: { status: string; approval: unknown }): string | null returning normalized HTTP(S) URL only when status is 'paused' and approval type is 'plannotator_gate'.

Create packages/web/src/lib/approval-context.test.ts testing literal fixtures for malformed metadata, omitted type backwards-compatibility, invalid enum values, non-paused runs, and unsafe/malformed URL protocols (e.g. javascript:).
Refactor packages/web/src/components/dashboard/WorkflowRunCard.tsx to remove its private URL helper and use getPlannotatorReviewUrl without changing dashboard behavior.
Tests pass via bun test src/lib/approval-context.test.ts src/components/dashboard/WorkflowRunCard.test.tsx in packages/web.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-type-rooms-legacy.md:392-611 (Task 1). Refactor WorkflowRunCard.tsx:118-133 and line 193. Keep URL parsing strictly http: or https:.

userStories.title: Add pure node-room classification
userStories.description: As a workflow operator, I want selected nodes classified into their proper room kinds, so that deterministic and control-flow nodes are never treated as agent chat.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/resolve-room-kind.ts exporting NodeBodyKind, RoomKind, RoomResolution, and resolveRoomKind(nodeId, definitionNodes, events, approval).
For authored DagNodes, inspect mutually exclusive body fields in exact priority: route_loop, loop_group, loop, plannotator_gate, approval, bash, script, workflow, command, prompt.
Recursively resolve qualified loop-group body IDs using dot-separated prefix matching (e.g. group.body, group.nested.check).

When definition lookup yields no match, evaluate fallbacks in order: matching child_workflow ApprovalContext -> workflow; matching approval/plannotator_gate/omitted ApprovalContext -> gate; node_routed event -> route_loop; latest typed bash/script event -> stdout; latest typed workflow event -> workflow; latest approval_requested event -> gate; otherwise agent with unknown nodeType.
Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/resolve-room-kind.test.ts asserting each authored mode, nested loop-group IDs, ApprovalContext fallbacks, and event fallbacks.
Do not call resolveNodeDisplay or import console detectVariant. Keep module free of React and mutable module state.
Tests pass via bun test src/components/workflows/resolve-room-kind.test.ts in packages/web.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-type-rooms-legacy.md:613-846 (Task 2) and Authoritative Interfaces :154-208. Consume DagNode and WorkflowEventResponse from @/lib/api and readApprovalContext from US-001.

userStories.title: Add attempt-scoped room data selectors
userStories.description: As a workflow viewer, I want room view models scoped strictly to the selected attempt, so that retries or reruns never display stale stdout, child IDs, or decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/select-room-data.ts exporting StdoutView, GateChrome, ChildRunRef, RouteDecisionView, LoopGroupChrome, and their five corresponding selector functions.

selectNodeStdout isolates events starting from row.id (matching step_name) and uses last terminal event in that attempt; later node_failed suppresses earlier completion; handles empty string stdout with exitCode 0; validates truncation boolean and originalBytes integer.

selectGateChrome sets canDecide only when runStatus is 'paused', ApprovalContext belongs to selected node, gate type is compatible, and resolved is null/undefined; extracts reviewUrl via getPlannotatorReviewUrl only for matching node; sets showInactiveNotice when paused on another/incompatible gate.

selectChildRun selects paused child_workflow ApprovalContext only when run is paused and nodeId matches; otherwise uses last selected-attempt workflow completion (fan_out, child_run_id, node_output); later failure suppresses earlier completion.
selectRouteDecision matches route_iteration execution_seq exactly and stringifies only safe primitives (string, finite number, boolean), returning null on missing or malformed fields.

selectLoopGroupChrome preserves authored body order, builds qualifiedId (prefix + child.id), copies depends_on, groups positive safe-integer iterations using last-event-wins, and derives direct body status per iteration.
Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/select-room-data.test.ts covering all selector cases, attempt isolation, and proving array-order precedence over timestamp sorting.
Tests pass via bun test src/components/workflows/select-room-data.test.ts in packages/web.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-type-rooms-legacy.md:848-1062 (Task 3) and Authoritative Interfaces :209-335. Uses LogRow, DagNode, WorkflowEventResponse, WorkflowRunStatus, readApprovalContext, and getPlannotatorReviewUrl.

userStories.title: Add LegacyNodeRoom dispatcher and shared header
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a single dispatcher for legacy node rooms with a shared header, so that selecting any node renders the correct room and suppresses transcript requests for non-agent nodes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/LegacyNodeRoom.tsx implementing LegacyNodeRoomProps (runId, row, isLive, loadMessages, definitionNodes, definitionPending, events, runStatus, approval, onApprove, onReject).
